description: This file is a Java test class named PersonNameTest, containing unit tests for the PersonName class in the OpenMRS project. It verifies methods like copying properties, content equality, and name formatting behaviors.

classes.name: PersonNameTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for testing the PersonName class functionalities including copying, equality, and formatting.

methods.name: newInstance_shouldCopyEveryPropertyOfGivenPersonName
methods.description: Tests that the newInstance method correctly copies all properties from an existing PersonName object.

methods.name: equalsContent_shouldReturnTrueIfAllFieldsOtherThanIdPersonAndPreferredAreEqual
methods.description: Verifies that equalsContent returns true when PersonName instances have identical content, ignoring IDs and preferred flags.

methods.name: equalsContent_shouldReturnFalseIfSuffixesAreNotEqual
methods.description: Checks if equalsContent correctly returns false when suffixes differ.

methods.name: equalsContent_shouldReturnFalseIfPrefixesAreNotEqual
methods.description: Checks if equalsContent correctly returns false when prefixes differ.

methods.name: equalsContent_shouldReturnFalseIfFamilyName2IsNotEqual
methods.description: Checks if equalsContent correctly returns false when familyName2 fields differ.

methods.name: equalsContent_shouldReturnFalseIfPrefixIsNotEqual
methods.description: Checks if equalsContent correctly returns false when prefixes differ.

methods.name: equalsContent_shouldReturnFalseIfDegreesAreNotEqual
methods.description: Verifies that equalsContent returns false when degrees differ.

methods.name: equalsContent_shouldReturnTrueIfOnlyInContentFieldsDifferenceIsBetweenNullAndEmptyString
methods.description: Ensures equalsContent treats null and empty strings as equivalent in content comparison.

methods.name: getFamilyName_shouldReturnObscuredNameIfObscure_patientsIsSetToTrue
methods.description: Tests that getFamilyName returns an obscured name if the configuration is set to obscure patient data.

methods.name: getFamilyName2_shouldReturnNullIfObscure_patientsIsSetToTrue
methods.description: Verifies getFamilyName2 returns null when obscuring is enabled.

methods.name: getFamilyNamePrefix_shouldReturnNullIfObscure_patientsIsSetToTrue
methods.description: Verifies getFamilyNamePrefix returns null when obscuring is enabled.

methods.name: getFamilyNameSuffix_shouldReturnNullIfObscure_patientsIsSetToTrue
methods.description: Verifies getFamilyNameSuffix returns null when obscuring is enabled.

methods.name: getGivenName_shouldReturnObscuredNameIfObscure_patientsIsSetToTrue
methods.description: Checks that getGivenName returns the obscured name if the setting is active.

methods.name: getMiddleName_shouldReturnObscuredNameIfObscure_patientsIsSetToTrue
methods.description: Checks that getMiddleName returns the obscured name if the setting is active.

methods.name: getPrefix_shouldReturnNullIfObscure_patientsIsSetToTrue
methods.description: Ensures getPrefix returns null when obscuring is enabled.

methods.name: getFullName_shouldNotPutSpacesAroundAnEmptyMiddleName
methods.description: Verifies that formatting the full name avoids extra spaces when middle name is empty.

methods.name: getFullName_shouldNotReturnLongIfPersonNameFormatIsShort
methods.description: Tests that full name adheres to the short format setting.

methods.name: getFullName_shouldNotReturnShortIfPersonNameFormatIsLong
methods.description: Tests that full name adheres to the long format setting.

methods.name: getFullName_shouldReturnShortIfPersonNameFormatIsNull
methods.description: Verifies fallback to short format when format setting is null.
